Follie — The Anesthesia Reference App Built for Students and Clinicians
Prep smarter. Study faster. Walk into every case with confidence.
Follie puts a complete anesthesia toolkit in your pocket — built by a clinician who knows exactly what you need at the bedside and in the classroom.
DRUG REFERENCE LIBRARY
Searchable database of anesthetic agents — induction agents, volatiles, muscle relaxants, opioids, reversal agents, vasopressors, local anesthetics, and more. Every entry includes dosing ranges, onset and duration, contraindications, side effects, and clinical pearls.
CLINICAL CALCULATORS
BMI, ideal body weight, estimated blood volume, allowable blood loss, MAC, ETT sizing, fluid calculations (4-2-1 rule, deficit replacement), and emergence time estimation — all in one place.
60+ QUICK REFERENCE CARDS
Cardiac, pulmonary, neuro, renal, hepatic, endocrine, hematologic, and psych comorbidities. Pediatric and OB anesthesia. Nerve blocks. Neuraxial techniques. Airway anatomy. ECG reference. TEG/ROTEM. Ventilator management. Positioning. Physics and gas laws. And more — all written in original, student-friendly language.
EMERGENCY PROTOCOLS
Weight-based emergency drug dosing for ACLS, PALS, BLS, malignant hyperthermia, bronchospasm, anaphylaxis, and local anesthetic toxicity (LAST). Fast access when seconds matter.
CASE LOGGING
Track your clinical cases — procedure, anesthetic type, techniques, rotation, role, duration, and personal notes. Build your case log throughout your training.
PREOP & SAFETY REFERENCES
ASA classification guide, preop medication hold/continue recommendations, NPO guidelines, ASRA neuraxial anticoagulation timing, and surgical antibiotic prophylaxis.
WHO IT'S FOR
Anesthesia students, residents, and practicing clinicians. Whether you're prepping for your first intubation or your thousandth, Follie has your back.

Built with care by Attuned Labs LLC.
Questions or feedback? Reach us at attunedlabs@gmail.com

Follie™ — The Anesthesia Reference App Built for Students and Clinicians

559 procedures. 1,372 comorbidities. 227 drugs. One app built by a clinician who knows what you actually need at the bedside.

Prep smarter. Study faster. Walk into every case with confidence.

ANESTHETIC PLAN GENERATOR (Patent Pending)
Enter patient data across 8 pages and Follie generates a complete anesthetic plan. 559 procedures across 21 specialties. All on-device, all instant.

COMORBIDITIES
1,372 conditions with anesthetic implications and structured preop/intraop/postop guidance — cardiac, pulmonary, neuro, endocrine, rheumatologic, psychiatric, and more.

EMERGENCY PROTOCOLS
Weight-based dosing for ACLS, PALS, MH, anaphylaxis, and LAST. Crisis checklists. Screen stays awake during emergencies.

DIFFICULT AIRWAY ALGORITHM
Interactive decision tree with FOI vs video laryngoscopy guide, SGA device comparison, obesity/OSA airway considerations, and post-extubation management.

MULTILINGUAL MEDICAL PHRASES
126 essential patient communication phrases in 7 languages — Spanish, Korean, German, Russian, Ukrainian, Arabic, and Somali — with pronunciation guides.

SURGEON & ANESTHESIA TEAM CARDS
Save preferences, temperament, teaching style, and notes for surgeons and anesthesia providers. Share cards with classmates via deep link.

DRUG REFERENCE LIBRARY
227 anesthetic agents across 24 browsable categories with dosing, onset/duration, contraindications, side effects, and clinical pearls.

CLINICAL CALCULATORS
39 calculators — BMI, IBW, EBV, ABL, MAC, ETT, fluids, ABG interpreter, opioid conversion, dP/dt & hypotension algorithm, oxygen delivery & consumption, osmolality, corrected calcium, body surface area, electrolyte correction, shunt fraction, SVR/PVR, RCRI, STOP-BANG, Apfel PONV, Caprini VTE, QTc, GCS, MELD, and more.

122 REFERENCE SHEETS
Comorbidities, subspecialty anesthesia, pharmacology, monitoring, emergency protocols, ICU management, bedside procedures, physiology, and more — all in original, student-friendly language.

MEDICAL TERMINOLOGY
1,127 searchable medical abbreviations A-Z with quick-jump sidebar.

QUICK HANDOFF
Document medications given, fluids, invasive lines, regional anesthesia, and vitals for PACU handoff. OCR scanner for medication lists.

OCR SCANNING
Scan medication lists, allergies, and surgical history with your camera. Adjustable crop. 1,372 comorbidities and 587 medications recognized.

CASE LOGGING
Track cases by procedure, anesthetic type, techniques, rotation, and role. Export to CSV.

ADDITIONAL TOOLS
Sign in with Apple or Google to sync across devices. PDF export. Pre-op checklist. Board prep quiz. Red screen mode. ASRA anticoagulation timing. NPO guidelines. ASA classification guide.

CLINICAL INTEGRITY
150+ individually cited references from Miller's, Stoelting's, Barash, ASA, ASRA, AHA, ACC/AHA, AABB, and more.

WHO IT'S FOR
Anesthesia students, residents, and practicing clinicians. Whether you're prepping for your first intubation or your thousandth, Follie has your back.
